findings.message: The 103 mock section (this copy and .specclaw/mock/index.html:1116) only describes the compliance test clock. It doesn't mention amendment 1, so the mock and change.md disagree about what 103 covers. Since amendment 1, the demo/e2e seed writes the Data retention purge log at now() - 4 days, so the 30-day card always shows 'Agent run logs 9,410'. Fix: add one sentence about the purge-log seed to the lede in both mock copies. The page is unchanged, so 'No screen changes' still holds.
findings.scenario: A reader opens #103-compliance-breach-clock to see what 103 changed. The section says only the compliance test changed, but apps/web/lib/privacy-fixtures.ts also changed, and that changes what the demo's Data retention card shows after 2026-11-11.
